summary: Now, look at Poster 4. This is my favourite poster!This is The Beautiful View From Space!First, look at the Earth. From space, Earth is so beautiful. Blue oceans, white clouds, and a golden sunrise. This is our beautiful home.Second, look at the stars and nebula. There are billions of stars in space. The nebula is pink and purple, like a colourful cloud. It is so amazing!Third, look at the ISS. That is the International Space Station. Astronauts live and work there. Sheikh Muszaphar also lived there for 9 days.And look, there is an astronaut floating in space. He is looking at Earth. Can you imagine how beautiful it is?So, we must protect our Earth, because it is the only home we have!Thank you!
